definitions.explanation: A built-in storage space in traditional Japanese rooms, typically used to store futons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To put the futon in the closet.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To take the blanket out of the closet.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{入|い}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{押|お}し{入|い}れ is a traditional Japanese-style closet.

Formation: {押|お}す (to push) + {入|い}れる (to put in) - items are 'pushed in'

Characteristics:
- Found in Japanese-style (washitsu) rooms
- Typically divided into upper and lower sections
- Traditionally used to store futons during the day
- Has sliding doors (fusuma or doors)

Contrast:
- {押|お}し{入|い}れ: traditional Japanese closet (in tatami rooms)
- クローゼット: Western-style closet (in Western-style rooms)
